text:
KubeAtlas

 English · 简体中文

 A self-hosted operations console for Kubernetes. Deploy KubeAtlas Hub and connect your clusters with KubeAtlas Agent to find failing workloads, trace dependencies, and see what changed.

Releases · Deploy Hub · Connect a cluster · Deploy with AI

 

 Hub hosts the web console and manages organizations, cluster access, and MCP credentials. Agent runs in each cluster and opens an outbound connection to Hub. Cluster operations are scoped to the selected organization and enforced by Kubernetes RBAC.

 What you can do

- Investigate issues with workload health, logs, events, and a timeline of resource changes. Cluster checks · Upgrade impact checks
- Explore applications and their resource dependencies, inspect live traffic when a source is available, and review Helm releases and Argo CD or Flux sync status. Integrations
- Review capacity and cost with scheduling requests, node capacity, and cost allocation. New releases bundle the offline files to install OpenCost from the Cost page on clusters with a compatible Prometheus. Capacity · Offline OpenCost
- Connect an AI client over MCP using a credential scoped to selected clusters and your permissions. Hub MCP

 Deploy Hub

Starting with v0.1.4, each Linux package includes the systemd service and the matching offline Agent catalog. Download one package for your distribution and architecture.

 Linux distribution Install command for amd64 
 --- --- 
 Debian or Ubuntu sudo apt install ./kubeatlas-portal 0.1.4 linux amd64.deb 
 RPM-based sudo dnf install ./kubeatlas-portal 0.1.4 linux amd64.rpm 

The packaged service listens on 127.0.0.1:1333 by default. Configure an HTTPS address reachable by your clusters, then use the one-time setup code to create the first administrator in your browser. Linux setup and upgrades

Helm · Docker Compose · v0.1.3 deployment guide

 Connect a cluster

1. Sign in to Hub and select Clusters → Connect cluster .
2. Run the generated command in a shell with access to the intended Kubernetes context. Hub supplies the Agent installer, Helm chart, and image.
3. Approve the matching code in Hub and check that the cluster is Connected . Agent onboarding

To hand the setup to an AI agent, share the deployment runbook or its raw Markdown.
